name: Rayleigh-Taylor
desc: Heavy fluid resting on light fluid — the most impatient arrangement in physics — where every dimple in the interface runs away into a falling spike, bubbles of light squeeze up between them, and each plunging tip shears itself into the iconic mushroom cap before the whole front shreds into a churning mixing layer that is fed from above and below and never settles; as two dyed fluids, the vorticity the spikes deposit, ironbow thermal, sumi ink wash, or spectral false-color.

energy.doc: effective gravity times Atwood number — how violently the heavy fluid falls (the master knob)

scale.doc: feature size — the amplitude of the seeded interface ripple, from a barely-disturbed sheet to deep fat plunging lobes

density.doc: COUNT of seeded interface modes — 0 gives a few clean fat mushrooms, 1 gives a broadband shredded front

visc.doc: viscosity — from a fine wispy shredded cascade through to thick syrupy lobes with smooth rims

hue.doc: hue of the light fluid (the heavy fluid takes the complement)

x.doc: horizontal phase of the interface ripple — slides which columns become spikes

y.doc: height the interface is hung at — how much room the spikes get to fall

style.doc: aesthetic: two dyed fluids with lit interfaces / abstracted vorticity showing the counter-rotating rolls inside every cap / ironbow thermal / sumi ink wash on paper / spectral false-color

seed.doc: deterministic seed for the interface's initial ripple spectrum — which modes grow
